title: Quinoa salad with chickpeas, feta and cucumber
steps: Rinse the quinoa, cook it in 200 ml salted water for 15 minutes and let it cool.
Rinse the chickpeas, dice the cucumber and tomatoes and finely chop the onion and herbs.
Whisk the lemon juice, oil and salt.
Toss everything together and crumble the feta over.
